column4: 見せしめとしては 最適だな！ = Perfect for making an example of them!
column5: The perfect example to make of them tangles the English idiom.
column6: The perfect example to make of them!\n\nI do hope it makes that woman reconsider a little... Very well, do it!
column7: This will make a perfect example of them! I do hope it makes that woman reconsider a little... Very well, do it!

column4: 麻酔を かがされた: made to inhale anesthetic
column5: Made me breathe anesthetic from behind is awkward and obscures the attacker's position.
column6: On my way home from school, someone suddenly made me breathe anesthetic from behind... I passed out... and when I came to, I was here...
column7: On my way home from school, someone came up behind me and forced me to inhale an anesthetic... I passed out... and when I came to, I was here...

column4: 理性のタガがふっ飛び: lose rational restraint
column5: The restraints on your reason will blow off is an awkward literal rendering; "a colossal psychic energy" is unnatural.
column6: When your beloved is hurt and your heart shakes with hatred and rage...! the restraints on your reason will blow off and a colossal psychic energy will erupt. That will be the birth of a terrifying psychic!
column7: When your loved one is hurt and your heart trembles with hatred and rage...! You'll lose all self-control, unleashing an enormous surge of psychic energy! That is how a terrifying psychic is born!

column4: その仏像は！？ = And where is that statue!?
column5: That statue!? obscures the retort that the supposedly protected statue is gone.
column7: Then where's the statue!? You, you...! TAILBONE-SPLITTER CHOP!
